summary: A revised Telnet protocol proposal from the committee, circulated for comments. Unless comments arrived within two weeks, they would not be considered for the official Telnet document. It lists the earlier notes it builds on. It was replaced by RFC 495.

eli5.summary: This is the second draft of the long invisible cable plan for logging in to far computers. People had two weeks to say what to change.
